messages:
Samir Patel: Heads upZenithGen launched late due to data center provisioning; they paid for a 6-node Dedicated pool for May but used ~2.5 nodes equivalent. Sales asks for pro-rate relief + short-term overage protection while they finish setup. Need decision today.

Nina (Sales): Details: monthly reserved fee $24,000 (6 nodes). Effective usage equivalent billed at reserved but customers asking a goodwill pro-rate of 60% of the monthly reserved fee for May (credit $14,400) and a 30% discount on any overage for next 1 billing cycle. They say it's critical to keep the integration intact.

Samir Patel: 60% credit seems high. Can we confirm actual usage numbers and whether contract allows any operational credits?

Oliver (Accounting): Contract standard language treats reserved fees as non-refundable. For audit, we need clear approval path and GL coding. Also if we do more than $5k, VP approval needed per policy.

Maya Chen: My threshold is $5k. $14,400 > $5k so would need VP Finance sign-off. Ask Sales to propose reduced relief or provide churn risk justification.

Nina (Sales): They insist it's a one-time supplier logistics issue and will go full utilization next month. They offered to sign an addendum acknowledging this is a one-off concession and not altering the commitment. Also offered a short-term marketing testimonial if we help.

Samir Patel: Can we counter: issue a credit memo for $5k now (within Deal Desk limits) and extend a 30% overage discount for one cycle conditional on customer acceptance? If they agree, we can escalate remaining amount to VP with documented ROI from Sales.

Ava (Legal): Draft clause: "Redwood Inference will issue a one-time credit memo in the amount of $5,000 applied to invoice ZG-2026-05. In addition, Customer will receive a 30% discount on billed overage charges for the next billing cycle (June 2026). This concession is a one-time goodwill allowance, does not modify the existing commitment, is non-transferable, and does not stack with other promotions. Customer must acknowledge acceptance by email within 7 business days." Need Sales acceptance email for audit.

Maya Chen: I approve the $5,000 credit memo and the 30% overage discount for one cycle provided Legal addendum and Sales captures acceptance email. For anything above $5k, escalate to VP Finance with churn/expansion justification. Please also tag GL 4-210-credits and record in concessions register under "Strategic pilot relief."

Oliver (Accounting): Will create credit memo CM-ZG-0506 for $5,000, GL 4-210-credits and ticket FIN-4349. Schedule for next billing run once we have customer ack and addendum. finance-bot created FIN-4349

finance-bot: Ticket FIN-4349 created by Oliver (Accounting) Credit memo CM-ZG-0506 $5,000 for ZG-2026-05, GL 4-210-credits. Addendum requested: 30% overage discount for June 2026 pending customer ack.

Nina (Sales): I'll send the addendum and push for their testimonial. Will attach acceptance to the ticket when received.

Samir Patel: Thanks all. If VP escalates, I'll prepare the business case. Mark as one-off in concessions ledger.

Maya Chen: Closing: Approved $5k CM, Legal addendum required, customer ack needed, escalate >$5k to VP. Tag: Q2 strategic concessions :white_check_mark:
